name: pronghorn-ai
description: Ask questions about Pronghorn's data, build data apps that follow VibeFoundry's conventions, and open the file viewer pane with one approval.

interface.shortDescription: Pronghorn data into applications, with a local file viewer
interface.longDescription: PronghornAI answers questions about the data in Pronghorn's hub and computes the exact structure a data application should have. A local pane shows your project's files and the plan as a chart; sign in to the hub from it to use private tables. Nothing about your project leaves your machine.
defaultPrompt: What tables are in Pronghorn's hub?
Build a pipeline from one of our tables
